# TFLM - TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers
# https://github.com/tensorflow/tflite-micro
# Tree generated by TFLM's own tools/project_generation/create_tflm_tree.py
# License: Apache 2.0
#
# Two kernel backends are available:
#   reference  - portable C++, always correct, no DSP
#   nmsis_nn   - generated from TFLM's cmsis_nn backend by tools/cmsis_to_nmsis.py,
#                calls into components/3rdparty/nmsis_nn, which picks up the
#                P-extension automatically from the app's xxldsp march
#
# This is the int8 world. It is deliberately independent of components/ai,
# whose uint8 kernels serve the .inm NPU path - a TFLM model on the CPU and a
# .inm model on the NPU can run concurrently, since iproai_npu_inference()
# blocks on a FreeRTOS semaphore and yields the core while the NPU computes.

__generate_library(1)

__component_add_include_dirs(.)
__component_add_include_dirs(third_party/flatbuffers/include)
__component_add_include_dirs(third_party/gemmlowp)
__component_add_include_dirs(third_party/ruy)
__component_add_include_dirs(third_party/kissfft)

# TFLM's own COMMON_FLAGS, minus the host-only bits.
__component_add_private_compile_options(-DTF_LITE_STATIC_MEMORY)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-DTF_LITE_DISABLE_X86_NEON)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-Os)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-fno-unwind-tables)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-ffunction-sections)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-fdata-sections)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-fmessage-length=0)
if(CONFIG_TFLM_STRIP_ERROR_STRINGS)
    __component_add_private_compile_options(-DTF_LITE_STRIP_ERROR_STRINGS)
endif()

# C++-only flags; the two kissfft files are C and must not see these.
__component_add_private_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>)
__component_add_private_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-exceptions>)
__component_add_private_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-threadsafe-statics>)
__component_add_private_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++17>)

# Upstream carries warnings we are not going to fix in a vendored tree.
__component_add_private_compile_options(-Wno-unused-parameter)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-Wno-sign-compare)
__component_add_private_compile_options(-Wno-type-limits)
__component_add_private_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-Wno-deprecated-declarations>)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source selection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB_RECURSE TFLM_SRCS RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
     tensorflow/*.cc)

# Test scaffolding is not part of a shipped library.
list(FILTER TFLM_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "tensorflow/lite/micro/test_helpers\\.cc$")
list(FILTER TFLM_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "tensorflow/lite/micro/test_helper_custom_ops\\.cc$")

# The optimized backend is opt-in; drop it unless it was asked for.
if(CONFIG_TFLM_NMSIS_NN_KERNELS)
    # TFLM's 14 kernel headers (conv.h, fully_connected.h, ...) gate on
    #     #if defined(CMSIS_NN)
    # to decide whether an optimized backend supplies Register_*_INT4/8/16(),
    # or whether the header should emit inline fallbacks that forward to the
    # generic Register_*(). In TFLM's vocabulary this macro means "an optimized
    # backend is present", not "the backend is literally CMSIS". Leaving it
    # undefined gives every one of those symbols two definitions - one inline
    # from the header, one from the backend .cc.
    #
    # It must reach the app too: micro_mutable_op_resolver.h pulls in the same
    # kernel headers, so an app TU compiled without it would disagree with the
    # library about which side of the #if it is on. Hence INTERFACE, not PRIVATE.
    __component_add_compile_definitions(CMSIS_NN)

    # These 14 reference kernels are the ones the NMSIS-NN backend replaces.
    # Keeping both would give the linker two definitions of each Register_*.
    set(TFLM_OPTIMIZED_KERNELS
        add batch_matmul conv depthwise_conv fully_connected maximum_minimum
        mul pad pooling softmax svdf transpose_conv transpose
        unidirectional_sequence_lstm)
    foreach(k ${TFLM_OPTIMIZED_KERNELS})
        list(FILTER TFLM_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "micro/kernels/${k}\\.cc$")
    endforeach()
else()
    list(FILTER TFLM_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "micro/kernels/nmsis_nn/")
endif()

# Audio front-end ops (FFT, filter banks). Pulls in kissfft.
if(CONFIG_TFLM_SIGNAL_OPS)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE TFLM_SIGNAL_SRCS RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
         signal/*.cc)
    list(APPEND TFLM_SRCS ${TFLM_SIGNAL_SRCS})
    __component_add_sources(third_party/kissfft/kiss_fft.c)
    __component_add_sources(third_party/kissfft/tools/kiss_fftr.c)
    __component_add_private_compile_options(-DFIXED_POINT=16)
endif()

__component_add_sources(${TFLM_SRCS})

# Bare-metal C++ runtime glue (see the file for why __dso_handle is needed).
__component_add_sources(port/tflm_cxx_runtime.cc)
